description.p: You calcify sturdy walls to form obstacles.
Walls are placed in a contiguous shape, beginning adjacent to you. Only empty spaces will form walls.
Creates walls with hit points each.
When enabled, automatically retrieves stones from your reserves to use as thrown weapons.
Thrown pebbles will continually be replaced as long as you have reserves remaining.
Stones deal damage at + PV and have a % chance to daze on hit
A new stone is sculpted every rounds, up to a reserve of
Thrown stones disappear after consecutive turns of not being held as a thrown weapon
While you have stones in reserve, they whorl about you and deflect physical projectiles (up to % at full reserve). Lasers and other energy attacks pass through.
Attune your sculpted stones to a keening resonance, or still them again.
Resonant stones penetrate as vibro weapons, meeting armor at its own frequency.
While attuned, your gravel whorl deflects light-based projectiles instead of physical ones and grants DV in place of AV.
Attuning retunes the stone in your hand at no cost. Direct beams pass through the whorl in either mode.
Carves an animate statue of the target creature from a target wall, inheriting its body plan and physique but not any mutations, skills, or equipment.
The statue guards you: nearby enemies must resist or direct their attacks at it.
After , the statue returns to lifeless stone, entombing anything it wore or carried.
You transfix an opponent with your unblinking gaze and slowly turn them to stone.
Taking any action other than passing the turn will break your gaze.
Each round your target makes a Toughness save; failures stiffen them (held in place, - Quickness), and successes shake off one stage of petrification. The save grows harder with each failure.
Targets that fail saves are permanently turned to stone; successes break the gaze entirely.
Targets that escape after or more failures are left partially petrified.
You crack open the earth and draw out its fruits.
Results vary by mutation rank.
